questions.prompt: What core components comprise the Canonical Observability Stack (COS)?
options: Prometheus, Loki, Grafana, Alertmanager, and Tempo
Datadog Agent, Splunk forwarder, and CloudWatch
questions.answer: Prometheus, Loki, Grafana, Alertmanager, and Tempo
questions.explanation: COS integrates Prometheus (metrics), Loki (logs), Grafana (dashboards), Alertmanager (alerts), and Tempo (traces) using charms.

questions.prompt: How do machine charms (on bare metal / LXD / VMs) typically forward metrics and system logs to COS?
options: Using the grafana-agent subordinate charm via the cos-agent relation
By manually copying log files over SCP using cron jobs
By opening port 9090 on the machine firewall for external scraping
By recompiling the Juju uniter agent with custom C++ extensions
questions.answer: Using the grafana-agent subordinate charm via the cos-agent relation
questions.explanation: grafana-agent runs as a subordinate charm on the principal machine, scraping local endpoints and forwarding telemetry to COS.

questions.prompt: Which relation interface is used to stream application logs to Loki in COS?
questions.explanation: Charms use the logging/log-proxy relation endpoints to forward log streams directly to Loki.
